title: Usage Insights: Export flow + permissions messaging (CSV download + share link)
creator: Tessa Morgan
body:
## Context
Usage Insights includes an export action (CSV) and a shareable report link. The export is security-sensitive (cost visibility + audit requirements), and we’ve already seen early beta confusion around totals and why exports are blocked.

This ticket covers the end-to-end UX for:
- Export confirmation (what will be exported, what filters apply)
- Export job creation + progress + download UX
- File naming conventions
- Permission denied states (view cost vs export vs share link)
- Error states (too large, throttled, expired link)

## Goals
1) Make it obvious what data is being exported (time range, timezone, filters, grouping).
2) Reduce support tickets by making permission and restriction messaging actionable (what role/setting is missing, who to contact).
3) Keep security/compliance happy: avoid leaking cost data via UI affordances; ensure export/share actions are clearly auditable.

## Non-goals
- Designing scheduled reports (explicitly out of scope for beta).
- Designing PDF exports (requested by CS for QBRs, but not in Phase 1).

## User stories
- As an eng lead/finops, I want to export the exact table I’m looking at to reconcile spend and share internally.
- As a workspace admin, I want exports to be controlled by role and logged.
- As a user without cost permissions, I should understand why export is disabled and how to request access.

## Proposed UX (Console)
### Entry points
- Primary: Usage → Cost Insights → Route/Model breakdown table toolbar: [Export CSV]
- Secondary: Top Cost Drivers view: [Export CSV] (exports current driver table + “What changed” deltas when applicable)

### Export confirmation modal
Trigger: user clicks [Export CSV].

Modal contents:
- Title: “Export CSV”
- Summary line: “Exports the current breakdown with your filters.”
- “Included in export” bullets:
  - Time range: e.g., “Last 7 days (2026-02-13 → 2026-02-20)”
  - Time zone: “UTC” (clickable info tooltip; see timezone notes)
  - Filters: Workspace, Project, Environment, Deployment mode, Region, Route, Model
  - Grouping: “Route + Model” (and any selected rollups)
  - Currency: “USD” (if multi-currency ever appears later, we’ll revisit)
- Size hint (if backend returns estimate): “Estimated rows: ~48,000” with warning threshold behavior.

Actions:
- Primary: [Start export]
- Secondary: [Cancel]
- Optional inline link: “Learn what’s included” → docs anchor in help center article.

### Export job UX (async)
After [Start export]:
- Close modal.
- Show toast: “Export started. We’ll notify you when it’s ready.”
- “View exports” link in toast takes user to an Exports panel (right drawer or page section).

Exports panel behavior:
- Shows a list of recent exports created by the user (and optionally by workspace, TBD with PM):
  - Name (file name)
  - Created time
  - Filters summary (compact)
  - Status: Preparing / Ready / Failed / Expired
  - Action: [Download] when ready

Download behavior:
- Clicking [Download] triggers file download via signed URL.
- If the signed URL is expired, show inline state: “Expired” + [Regenerate] (only if user still has permission).

### File naming spec (user-visible)
Goal: deterministic + readable + sortable.

Format (proposal):
- redwood-usage-insights__{workspace_slug}__{project_slug_or_all}__{view}__{yyyy-mm-dd}_{yyyy-mm-dd}__{tz}.csv

Examples:
- redwood-usage-insights__heliochat__prod__route-model__2026-02-13_2026-02-20__UTC.csv
- redwood-usage-insights__acmeai__all-projects__top-drivers__2026-02-01_2026-02-29__America-Los_Angeles.csv

Notes:
- Use double underscores as separators to avoid issues with hyphens in slugs.
- Replace spaces with hyphens; keep ASCII-safe.
- If filters are too long, truncate slugs with an ellipsis-friendly cut (UI shows full name; file name remains stable).

### Permission states and messaging
We need to differentiate:
A) Can’t view cost at all
B) Can view cost but can’t export
C) Workspace restricted from exporting (policy)
D) Feature not enabled (beta allowlist)

#### A) No cost visibility permission
- Hide cost values and hide Export CTA entirely.
- Show a banner in the insights section:
  - Title: “You don’t have permission to view cost data.”
  - Body: “Ask a Workspace Admin to grant you the Cost Viewer role, or request access in Workspace settings.”
  - CTA: [Request access] (opens a lightweight modal with copy-to-clipboard message or links to internal process; PM to confirm flow)

#### B) Can view cost but no export permission
- Export button is visible but disabled (discoverability), with tooltip:
  - Tooltip: “Export is restricted. Ask a Workspace Admin to grant Export permission.”
- Clicking disabled button should NOT open modal; it should open a small permission dialog:
  - Title: “Export restricted”
  - Body: “You can view cost insights, but exporting is limited to users with Export permission.”
  - Secondary info: “Exports are logged for auditing.”
  - CTA: [Contact admin] (shows workspace admins list if available; otherwise links to docs)

#### C) Workspace policy disallows export
Examples: restricted workspaces, certain Private deployments, retention controls.
- Export button is visible but disabled.
- Tooltip: “Exports are disabled by your workspace policy.”
- Dialog copy:
  - Title: “Exports disabled by policy”
  - Body: “This workspace has downloads disabled to meet compliance requirements.”
  - Guidance: “If you need data outside the console, contact your admin or Security to review the policy.”
  - CTA: [View policy] (deep link to Workspace → Security/Compliance settings page)

#### D) Beta flag not enabled
- If the whole page is gated, user won’t see the export. If the page is visible but export isn’t:
  - Export button hidden (avoid confusing partial feature).
  - Optional inline note in page footer: “Export is available in the Usage Insights beta.”

### Error states (export job)
- Too large:
  - Error banner in modal before starting export if estimate exceeds threshold:
    - “This export is too large for a single file.”
    - Suggestion: “Try a shorter time range (≤ 7 days) or narrow filters.”
  - If backend fails after starting: job status shows Failed with reason string and suggested fixes.

- Rate limit / throttling:
  - Toast: “Too many exports in a short period. Try again in a few minutes.”

- Partial data / freshness lag:
  - If page already shows “Data delayed” banner, mirror this in the export modal:
    - “Your export will reflect the same freshness as the table.”

## Accessibility notes
- Export confirmation modal: focus trap, ESC closes, button labels explicit.
- Disabled export: tooltip accessible (aria-describedby) and dialog available via keyboard.
- Export status: use text + icons, not color-only; screen-reader announcements for “Ready to download”.

## Open questions
1) Should Exports panel show only “my exports” or allow admins to view workspace exports? (Security leaning: my exports for beta.)
2) Shareable report link: do we ship in beta? If yes, does it require same permission as export + does link obey RBAC at view-time?
3) Do we expose “estimated rows” reliably from backend for all queries?
4) Exact roles naming: “Cost Viewer”, “Cost Admin”, “Export” permission—confirm with Auth/RBAC and Security.

## Deliverables
- Figma: export modal + exports panel + permission dialogs + tooltips (desktop + responsive)
- Copy deck: strings for tooltips/dialogs/errors (ready for implementation)
- Spec notes for file naming rules and truncation behavior

## Acceptance criteria
- Every permission scenario has a distinct UI with actionable next step.
- Export includes clear summary of filters/timezone/grouping.
- File name is deterministic and matches spec.
- Error states cover: too large, throttled, failed job, expired download.

## References
- Confluence: Usage Insights Console UX spec (IA + tables) (link)
- Confluence: Usage Insights API contract (export job lifecycle) (link)
- Slack: export flow discussion (async vs sync, audit logging) (link)
- Jira: SUP-24863 timeouts for long time ranges (link)
comments: 2026-01-30 — Alicia Perez: Drafted initial export confirmation modal + file naming proposal. Added explicit timezone display after DevEx feedback that finance exports need consistency with billing (UTC).

2026-02-03 — Marcus Lin (Security): Please avoid showing export CTA to users without cost view permission. For users who can view cost but cannot export, disabled CTA is acceptable if copy is clear that exports are audited. Also ensure policy-based disables don’t suggest “request access” if policy cannot be overridden by role.

2026-02-05 — Dylan Brooks: Backend is async export with signed URLs; plan for “Ready/Failed/Expired” states is good. Regenerate link is feasible but should create a new audit event; design should clarify whether regenerate is “new export” or “new download link.”

2026-02-07 — Alex Martinez (DevEx): Suggest changing wording from “route” to “endpoint” in user-facing dialogs where possible. For export naming, keep “route-model” in file name but show “Endpoint + Model” in UI label to reduce confusion.

2026-02-11 — Naomi Feldman (Product/Security): Need a distinct state for “exports disabled by workspace policy” vs “you don’t have export permission.” Please link to Workspace → Security settings and avoid implying admin can always grant export.

2026-02-18 — Alicia Perez: Updated spec: (1) hide export entirely for no-cost-permission users; (2) disabled export + dialog for no-export-permission; (3) separate policy-disabled dialog + View policy CTA. Added note that share links (if shipped) must re-check RBAC at view-time.
2026-02-20 — Tessa Morgan: Marking In Review pending final copy review with DevEx and a quick pass with Security on exact role names. Targeting handoff to ENG-3816 by 2026-02-24.
